svg.text: Recommended Target Architecture — .NET 10 Host over Pi's Existing Protocol Seam
Option C, with an Option B upgrade path. Pi's runtime is preserved unmodified, so 100% of extensions, skills, prompts and themes keep working.
new — ~1,200 LOC port of the TS client
New code you own. Everything above the protocol line is idiomatic .NET.
Zero fork. Track upstream releases (~2.7/week) by version-pinning, not by re-porting.
The sidecar is an implementation detail of the container image — callers see a single .NET service.
if a .NET-native TUI becomes mandatory, extend pi-protocol with component-tree messages and proxy pi-tui rendering —
an additive change to the same seam, not a second migration. Everything already built against the protocol keeps working.
